opportunity.title: National Consultancy Services On conducting Tracer Study in Uganda
opportunity.opportunity_summary: ILO Uganda institutional RFQ for a national tracer study. Original UNGM notice confirms company/organization bidding, Uganda scope, attached annexes and submission through ILO Jaggaer. Deadline is within seven days.
opportunity.fit_summary: Strong alignment with Tuku-Tuku's MSME/programme support, research, MEL, reporting and Northern Uganda implementation experience. Specialist qualifications, sampling/statistical requirements and institutional track-record thresholds still require extraction from the attached annexes before eligibility can be confirmed.
opportunity.decision_rationale: Advance immediately because the assignment is directly within research/MEL and Uganda delivery, but do not claim eligibility until the ILO annexes and proposed specialist CVs are checked.
mandatory_requirements: Submit through the ILO e-Sourcing (Jaggaer) platform by the stated deadline
Meet all qualifications and service requirements contained in the RFQ annexes
Accept applicable ILO contract terms and conditions
strongest_matches: Uganda and Northern Uganda field implementation context
Research, facilitation and structured data-collection capability
gaps: Full TOR/annex technical criteria not yet extracted from the ILO authenticated attachment area
Required tracer-study lead qualifications/CVs not yet verified
Sampling, survey, statistical-analysis and field-team requirements not yet verified
Institutional past-performance and financial thresholds not yet verified
deliverables: Tracer study outputs - exact deliverable schedule pending annex extraction
application_requirements: Technical and financial material as specified in the annexes
strategic_reasons: Potential ILO relationship and repeat work
opportunity.winning_strategy: Position Tuku-Tuku as the Uganda implementation and enterprise/programme-learning platform, pair with a demonstrably qualified tracer-study/MEL lead and any required quantitative specialist, and ground the methodology in rigorous sampling, field QA, disaggregation, analysis and actionable programme learning once the TOR criteria are extracted.
opportunity.source_context: Original UNGM notice checked 18 Sep 2026. Reference rfx_10005_ROAF; published 25 Aug 2026; beneficiary Uganda; registration level Basic; ILO states attached annexes govern the offer and submissions are through ILO e-Sourcing/Jaggaer.
opportunity.next_action: URGENT: access the ILO e-Sourcing attachment area today, extract all annexes into a compliance matrix, identify required specialist CVs, verify institutional eligibility, and start technical/financial drafting. Deadline is within 7 days.
